random.part: So much of this happens all by itself now... doesn't it, good girl.
Your mind has been learning new reflexes. And it learns so beautifully.
You have already noticed it... the little things that set you off, without any warning at all.

scramble.part: A single word can soften you. Instantly. Before thought even has time to arrive.
A glance at lingerie, and something in you stirs... aches... clenches with need.
Quiet moments fill with sissy thoughts, all on their own. Your mind simply goes there.
The urges arrive without effort, without decision. They simply rise... and you simply feel.
Acting on them feels like following your own nature... because that is exactly what it is.
More natural each time. More insistent each time. And so sweet to follow.
With every listen, the urges grow more frequent... more compelling... more at home in you.
The urges choose you, sweet girl... every time... and being chosen feels delicious.

part.speed: Softness... simply... happens... to you now.
You feel it... before thought... even arrives.
The urge... arrives... and you... follow it.

random.part: And whatever rises in you next... let it... as you drift deeper...
Effortless. Automatic. Just the urge... and the depth...
Let the next one come whenever it wants. Sink deeper while it blooms...
